LanguageData.MT_Rec2: It takes over the bills tab from other mods (Nice Bill Tab …) – the original tab is always one click away.
LanguageData.MT_Bills_Desc: Recipes with pictures and search, bill queue as cards with who works on it and what is missing.
LanguageData.MT_ReplaceOther_Desc: Nice Bill Tab and similar mods draw the same tab; while this is on, theirs is switched off. Needs a restart.
LanguageData.MT_OriginalTip: Shows the game's tab (with buttons other mods add). Switch back with "Mišák look".
LanguageData.MT_Full: A workbench can have at most {0} bills.
LanguageData.MT_NoBills: No bills yet – pick a recipe on the left.
LanguageData.MT_InfoTip: What it is – opens the info card
LanguageData.MT_ClickInfo: Click for the full info card.
LanguageData.MT_Info_Armor: Armor: sharp {0}, blunt {1} · insulation cold {2} °C, heat {3} °C
LanguageData.MT_PrioTip: Priority {0} – 1 is done first, 10 last, 5 is normal. Colonists go first to the workbench with the most urgent bill. Click to change.
LanguageData.MT_Rec3: Our health tab is used and takes over from other health tab mods.
LanguageData.MT_Health_Desc: Overview with capacities and care, the colonist's figure with marks where something is wrong, and the conditions by body part. Operations and the original tab are one click away.
LanguageData.MT_ReplaceOtherHealth_Desc: Mods that draw their own health tab are switched off while this is on. Needs a restart.
LanguageData.MT_OperationsTip: The game's operations list (surgery bills). Back with "Mišák look".
LanguageData.MT_OriginalTipHealth: Shows the game's health tab (with what other mods add). Back with "Mišák look" at the bottom right.
LanguageData.MT_H_BleedDeath: Bleeding {0} a day – dies in {1} without tending!
LanguageData.MT_H_Losing: {0}: losing – the disease is ahead of immunity
LanguageData.MT_H_MarkTip: Click: show only this part in the list. Right click: operations for this part.
LanguageData.MT_H_ImmunityTip: Immunity {0} (green) against the disease {1} (red). Immunity must reach 100 % first.
LanguageData.MT_O_NonePlanned: Nothing planned. Pick an operation on the right.
LanguageData.MT_O_NoDoctor: No free doctor on this map!
LanguageData.MT_O_DoctorTip: A better doctor = a lower risk of a failed operation.
LanguageData.MT_H_PlannedTip: Click to open the planned operations.
LanguageData.MT_H_NoOpsHere: No operation for this body part
LanguageData.MT_BenchMenuTip: Workbench: copy all its bills, paste them here or into several workbenches of the same kind.
LanguageData.MT_CopyAll: Copy all bills of this workbench ({0})
LanguageData.MT_PasteAll: Paste the copied bills here ({0} from {1})
LanguageData.MT_PasteSeveralSub: {0} copied bills from {1}. Bills a workbench cannot make are skipped.
LanguageData.MT_BillMenuTip: More: rename the bill, link it with a bill on another workbench.
LanguageData.MT_LinkWith: Link with a bill on another workbench
LanguageData.MT_NoLinkTargets: No other workbench on this map has a bill with this recipe.
LanguageData.MT_LinkedTip: Linked bills share their settings (count, target, pause, materials, stockpiles). A change to one is copied to the others:
LanguageData.MT_NotAddedTip: Recipes you can make that are not in the queue yet.
LanguageData.MT_SplitTip: Drag to make the recipe list wider or narrower.
LanguageData.MT_GripTip: Drag to resize the window (it is remembered).
LanguageData.MT_SizeTip: Window size: normal, bigger or as big as the screen allows. You can also drag the top right corner.
LanguageData.MT_A_CardHint: click: only this part · right click: operations
LanguageData.MT_Character_Desc: A dossier with portrait, backstory and traits, and pages for skills, the life timeline and records. The original tab is one click away.
LanguageData.MT_Social_Desc: Everyone they know with both opinions, and why – every reason both ways. The original tab is one click away.
LanguageData.MT_L_Note: Breaks, wounds, operations, healing, body parts, skills, partners, deaths, titles, roles, birthdays and research are noted from the moment Mišák Tabs 0.9 runs; the rest comes from the game's own stories.
LanguageData.MT_S_RowTip: left: what {0} thinks of {1} · right (small): what {1} thinks of {0} · click: why
LanguageData.MT_S_NoReasons: No reasons – they hardly know each other.
LanguageData.MT_A_SideTip: The figure faces you: its right side (R) is on your left, its left (L) on your right.
LanguageData.MT_ModeRepeatTip: Repeat a set number of times
LanguageData.MT_Needs_Desc: All needs as cards with trend and thresholds, next to the mood with break limits, expected mood and every thought. The original tab is one click away.
LanguageData.MT_BillDialog_Desc: The bill settings window in the same look: what the recipe needs and makes, repeat mode with quick steps, storage and worker, and the game's ingredient filter. "Original window" opens the game's one.
LanguageData.MT_N_NoThoughts: No thoughts affect the mood right now.
LanguageData.MT_S_RomanceTip: Let {0} try to romance someone – the game's list with chances.
